description.value: You muffle sound, dim light, and mask scent around yourself and those nearby. Each creature you choose within 30 feet of you, yourself included, gains a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for the duration and cannot be tracked by non-enhanced means while within that radius, leaving no trace of its passing.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
